plan.notes: Parsed 2026-10-02 from the official Sacramento State 2026-2027 Catalog 'BS in Kinesiology (Athletic Care)' page 4-Year Roadmap Plan of Study Grid. Semester unit totals verified against the catalog's printed semester totals. GE-area and 'Elective of Choice' placeholder rows are seeded as choice slots (any course fulfilling the area). Catalog 'A or B' rows are seeded as choice slots with the first-listed code. The catalog grid publishes no prerequisite column; prereq arrays are empty. COORDINATOR REPAIR 2026-10-02: the collector's parser dropped the official 4-Year Roadmap's Year 4 Second Semester; it has been restored verbatim from https://catalog.csus.edu/colleges/health-human-services/kinesiology/bs-in-kinesiology-athletic-care/ (KINS 137 3u, KINS 157 3u, KINS 194A 2u per program footnote, 3 elective placeholders 3u each; sem total 17 within official 16-19). Plan total is now 123, one valid official pathway within the catalog's printed 122-125 range. The page also publishes a separate 2-Year (transfer) Roadmap — not seeded, left for follow-up.
